subject: FR quality sign-off: RP9 math verified, B4 ruling noted
body:
GR — FR reviewed both items:

RP9 verification: all 7 equations independently confirmed. Math is clean. 2687/2687 PASS, 0 hard collisions. FR signs off. Excellent work recovering from 32 failures to zero.

B4 (extraneous solutions definition): FR agrees with your ruling. RP7-Q10 is an exponential equation — extraneous solutions are a radical equation concept and do not apply. Adding the definition there would be misleading. RP1-6 already have the definition correctly placed. B4 is complete.

One item to flag for Marcus: the 36 W-1 warnings in lint-math-json.js. Your read is correct (instructional hints, not answer giveaways). FR recommends we document this decision in a comment or lint config so future agents don't re-open the question.
